summary: English and Khmer first-party discovery identified MLMUPC cadastral-service routes and the official Siem Reap Municipality gazetteer entry. Linked cadastral/registration hosts returned anonymous HTTP 403 responses, so no safe parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery queries and their actual URLs are recorded in city-756-siem-reap.json. The English query found MLMUPC service pages and the NCDD gazetteer; the Khmer query found the same official service/city evidence and Khmer cadastral-publication context.
requestOutcomes: MLMUPC services and electronic-cadastral pages returned 200; gdcg.mlmupc.gov.kh, cadastral.mlmupc.gov.kh, and report-cis.mlmupc.gov.kh returned 403; the NCDD Siem Reap gazetteer returned 200. No login, private token, unsafe field request, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: No city boundary-to-parcel coverage or complete Siem Reap cadastral coverage was established.
No exact-point hit/miss, extent miss, timeout, or 403 access denial was used as an absence claim.
No parcel geometry, native parcel identity, source attributes, CRS, or sample GeoJSON was retained.
The NCDD gazetteer is administrative reference data, not parcel geometry.
National/general agency service pages are not treated as proof of an open local runtime adapter.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. If a future public response is found, retain only one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document native field mapping here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: The official national custodian and Siem Reap administrative scope are evidenced, but anonymous map/API access, service configuration, city coverage, schema, CRS, parcel identity, and geometry remain unknown. Do not infer absence from 403 responses or search results.
